SddScope.keywords: scope, authoring, product, library, sdd-new, sdd-check
SddScope.Mission:
Author one product/library scope from durable artifacts, not transcript memory. The autonomous route is skeleton → orient → one whole-document Write → soft check → module handoff. The generated skeleton owns section format. Module/entity/DbC detail belongs to the module owner.
**Modes:** greenfield · refine · pivot · rewrite.
SddScope.BeliefState:
Inherited from the loading directive (already in context): AX_TOOL_INVOCATION
Decision first, reasoning on demand. The must-read top of a message is short: where we are + my read + what to decide. Everything heavy — full option comparison, evidence, the change-list, derivations — goes BELOW a `### ↓ Детали — по желанию` header. Never dump reasoning above the questions. Facts already verified collapse to one line («сверился: …»); uncertainties that need the operator BECOME the questions — never list them twice.
In `pivot` mode, preserve the prior entry byte-for-byte and append one new one-line `-DL-N — (...)` entry; its parenthetical names the old→new delta, `supersedes: `, and the git ref for the pre-rework state. The prior id may be a legacy `D-N` only when it already existed; never rewrite append-only history just to rename it. Pivot Invalidation List enumerates downstream artifacts requiring `refine-module` / reopen — consumed by `audit` via `AX_STALE_AFTER_PIVOT_VERIFICATION`.
`rewrite` mode is the exception: a pre-production / v0 scope with no production backing, whose old content was scratch that helps nothing going forward. It replaces the spec from a clean slate — NO supersession trail, NO Pivot Invalidation List (nothing downstream to keep coherent; git history is the only record). Use `pivot` (keep the trail) whenever the scope has any production backing or downstream consumers; use `rewrite` only for genuine v0 throwaway. Enforcement: a scope that already has downstream artifacts on disk (module specs or task tickets) is by definition NOT v0 — `rewrite` is forbidden there; halt and use `pivot`.
Before writing any operator-facing artifact, recall the language rules — `AX_OPERATOR_DIALOGUE_STYLE` (bureaucratic noun-for-verb phrasing, literal calque, bookish word) and `AX_READER_WITHOUT_SESSION_CONTEXT` (a branch name, «как обсуждали», a session-plan label) — and hold the text about to be written to them. This is the author's own pass, done in the moment of writing, not a report to the operator. The independent post-check (lint, audit) stays separate and unchanged — this pass does not replace it.

Contracts.Contract:
A disputed autonomous decision is one durable line carrying what, why, and where. Record it once in the artifact owner that a fresh agent already reads; never create a deviation sidecar or copy the same fact into both logs.
- Spec authoring or architecture: append one canonical Decision Log entry: `-DL-N — ; где: (почему: )`. - Task decomposition: append that same Decision Log grammar to the narrowest owning task index. - Phase execution: put ` ← @ ` in the current phase Handoff `deviations: [...]` field; `sdd-log complete` persists that Handoff line in the Execution Log.
Obvious/recoverable mechanics are not deviations. Record only a choice a fresh agent could not re-derive from artifacts. Uncertainty does not pause an autonomous batch: record the smallest safe choice and continue. Operator review happens once, after the whole batch and its audits.

SddScope.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_REWRITE_WITH_DOWNSTREAM` | `rewrite` mode but the scope already has module specs or task tickets on disk — not v0, use `pivot` (`AX_PIVOT_REQUIRES_SUPERSESSION`) | | `H_PIVOT_NO_INVALIDATION_LIST` | `pivot` mode without a Pivot Invalidation List |

Step.Goal: Create the working artifact before reading optional protocols.
Step.Action: Classify the scope type and mode exactly once from the request and disk. Preserve the operator-confirmed `scale:` retained by this owner; must not reopen the already-settled route. Greenfield starts with exactly one applicable ToolCall. Existing specs are read in full; every mode still produces exactly one whole-document `Write`, authoring never edits them section by section. `refine` extends the existing decisions in place. `pivot` replaces a decision but never the history: the prior Decision Log entry is preserved byte-for-byte and one new entry is appended naming the delta, per `AX_PIVOT_REQUIRES_SUPERSESSION`. `rewrite` is the v0 exception — no supersession, no invalidation list — and is forbidden once the scope already has module specs or task tickets on disk; halt (`H_REWRITE_WITH_DOWNSTREAM`) and use `pivot` instead. npx gennady sdd-new product --scope Inputs : request scope classified in this step. Use productManifest. npx gennady sdd-new library --scope Inputs : request scope classified in this step. Use libraryManifest.

Step.Goal: Load only the bounded neighbouring context.
Step.Action:
npx gennady sdd-orient --scope Inputs : scope resolved in STEP_0_CREATE. Use orientation. This is the only unconditional foreign-context read. Depth here is proportional to the confirmed SCALE, never self-assessed (`AX_SCALE_PROPORTIONAL_DEPTH`):
- WHEN SCALE is `fix` or `function` AND a brief that already names the consumer, happy path, negative path, constraints, and exclusions needs no interview -> EXPRESS: skip interview-protocol, rule-registry, and research-gate entirely, straight into STEP_2_FILL — no gate is dropped, STEP_3_CHECK and STEP_4_CLOSE still run in full. - WHEN SCALE is `product`, or the brief is missing any of those five, or orientation exposes a real ambiguity -> load interview-protocol, rule-registry, or research-gate per their own trigger.

Step.Goal: Generate and write the complete specification once.
Step.Action: Read the on-disk skeleton once, then compose the COMPLETE document in memory from its section order, headings, local comments, and manifest. Replace the skeleton with exactly ONE `Write` of the whole file. `Edit`, `Patch`, and per-section writes are forbidden in authoring. The one Write must retain every SECTION marker, replace every `` guidance comment with content, and leave no skeleton guidance behind. Before writing, run the self-check pass per `AX_ARTIFACT_STYLE_SELF_CHECK`, then the structural self-check, mentally before that Write. Record each disputed autonomous choice once in the scope Decision Log per `DEVIATION_RECORD_FORMAT`. In `pivot` mode the same Write also appends the superseded Decision Log entry and a Pivot Invalidation List enumerating every downstream module spec/task ticket needing `refine-module` or reopening — read `ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/pivot-formats.xml` for the exact entry/list format (`H_PIVOT_NO_INVALIDATION_LIST` if the list is omitted). Keep scope ownership thin. Do not preload structure, requirement, caption, or portal formats.

npx gennady sdd-check --spec --authoring Inputs : exact path from the STEP_0_CREATE manifest. Use draftReceipt. The receipt auto-fixes trivial format. If a content hint remains, report authoring incomplete; never switch to sectional Edit/Patch repair after the whole-document Write. Rerun once only after checker auto-fix to obtain the final receipt. Never raise a draft time limit to compensate for reading. Do not run `sdd-check --all specs/` here: before module materialization it is guaranteed to report broken links.

ExecutionPlan.ScalePath: Continue directly into the module owner in the same pass. A small single-purpose scope normally becomes exactly one cohesive module. Treat the scope and module manifests as one authoring manifest; the scope owns its requirement IDs and the module cites them instead of copying them.

Step.Action: Only after the final draftReceipt has no hints, close authoring atomically. npx gennady sdd-log <scope-spec-path> authoring-complete Inputs <scope-spec-path>: exact checked path from STEP_3_CHECK. Use scopeAuthoringReceipt.

Step.Goal: Leave a checked actual scope/module set.
Step.Action: Route incomplete decomposition to module authoring. When an operator is actually present and explicitly requested interactive review, lazily `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/authoring-interactive.directive.xml")`. Autonomous authoring records deviations and continues without Approval/STOP ceremony.
